note: Franky's notebook. Written by the duck itself (the model's weights never change). tries = attempts the note was shown in, wins = how many of those succeeded.

knowledge.text: The harness will stop the attempt if 10 consecutive tool calls change nothing.
The vision model returned no box in multiple pictures, including #2, #4, #8, #10, #12, #14, #16, #18, #21, #24, and #27.
Walking forward 0.3 m was refused due to proximity to the table edge.
For successful pickup, the object's middle must be near the beak tip, and its long side must be close to perpendicular to the direction faced.
